mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, slot_name, option_value, preference_type, confidence, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM diet_user_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_user_preference ( user_id, slot_name, option_value, preference_type, confidence, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{slotName}, #{optionValue}, #{preferenceType}, #{confidence}, #{expiresAt}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE confidence = VALUES(confidence), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), updated_at = NOW()
